author: Opaxzity
body:
First of all I am posting on avicus because when i sent on gmail they said post it here. The registeration was down and i finally got to create a account with my brother's account.  I am Pyrxis also known as QuickDropEz. I was banned about 2 to 3 month ago for Hacking. I know that what I did was bad and it was my mistake. I realize how hacking makes other people's game play boring and unfair and that it gives me a tremendous advantage over others who are playing fairly. I know that I deserve my punishment and I should be banned but I hope I can be given a second chance. I already deleted all my hacks and I know that hacks should not be allowed. And also I can help the community by maybe building new maps for games and inviting more friends. I am also good at plugins and coding.

The main problem is that my friend Josio_Swaglord who invited me to this server got banned for my mistakes. He came over to my house one day and logged into my computer and I think he got (IP ban because he wasnt hacking and he got instantly banned.) then I have anothers friends account called bigberryj and I went on and got banned instantly with that also. We dont have any hacks.


Josiah has been inviting a lot of friends to this server about (6~8) Including 7en (_Ubi), Greffen? , xHajiPajix, eliisac, TheEndMaster, Localheist123, CaptinPengin?, Mike4play?, and a lot lot more. He spent more than 18 hours on this server and this is his first server and his favorite. He is pretty new to minecraft so he doesnt really know all about hacking, ban, forum, etc. He is really sad that he got banned on his server.


He shouldn't be banned and I should deserve the punishment. I am the one who was hacking and I am the one who should be banned. I hope you can unban Josiah for he has done nothing wrong and he have done a lot to the community. Thank you for spending your precious time on reading my appeal. I hope you guys at least take into consideration of unbanning Josiah and my friends account bigberryj. Thank you again.


~Pyrxis formerly known as QuickDropEz


PS: I am writing this appeal for Josio_Swaglord because he is really new to minecraft and he downst know about ban and unban and appeal and forum and etc. I had to explain it all to him. I really do hope he can be unban and play avic.us with his friends agin. Thank your so much. BTW one of the friend Josiah invited is Localheist123 and he has a youtube channel where he sometimes upload avicus videos and he is getting some subscribers quickly.

AND somehow on gmail they said that there is no way to prove that me and Josio_Swaglord is different. He is my friend and if you want me to prove it skype me on (Pryxis / Haon) and ill tell u the details cause it  is private information and i dont want people to know about my location realname identity etc. Thank you


Also im posting this here cause i posted it on appeal an infraction and it wont show up on other forum account so iwas wondering if its not working right now
